scope: Explicit 16/32-bit IRET and RETF from 64-bit entry

reference.document: Intel SDM 325462-090, IRET/IRETD/IRETQ and RET; Volume 3A section 7.14.3

implementation.domain: V6 and inheriting V7/V8 retain their 64-bit CPL0 entry, disabled CET/FRED, successful ordinary sequential RAM and no asynchronous event domain. Canonical CF/CB/CA imm16 with no prefix, 66 or 48 select dword, word or qword frame fields.
implementation.lifter: All IRET operand widths begun in 64-bit mode pop five frame fields, even at the same target CPL. The earlier narrow lift incorrectly named only three. Legacy i386 admission is unchanged.
implementation.admission: One frame-return reader binds exact bytes, field sizes, addresses and terminal intrinsic shape. It derives unsigned immediate cleanup once. Noncanonical prefix combinations remain native requests.
implementation.state: Narrow IP/SP fields zero-extend before target-mode stack rules. Word IRET preserves RF/AC/ID/VIF/VIP; wider IRET restores those bits from the frame. Existing target cache, segment invalidation, NMI, monitor and conditional high-half behavior is shared.
implementation.memory: The shared descriptor owner reads exactly the requested field width and forwards a pending accessed bit only when it lies within that field. Same-CPL RETF does not require absent saved SP/SS fields.
implementation.public_export: All three operand widths publish the same eight conditional compatibility choices, consume one driver step, stop before a selected target and refuse compatibility reentry without another budget charge.
implementation.compiler: Existing LLVM/NeverC native frame APIs need no source changes. NeverC still supports x86_64/aarch64 frontend targets; its deliberate i386 target refusal is separate from LLVM's i386 intrinsic backend.

qualification.native_observations: Independent KVM original instructions provide GPR, flags, IP, segment/cache, descriptor-table and event-state observations, plus all affected descriptor/frame RAM. Four independent high-half choices preserve every defined bit. This legacy oracle does not independently sample arbitrary full XSAVE/vector banks.
qualification.matrix: Both narrow widths; IRET and RETF plain/imm7/imm65535; target CPL0..3, 64-bit and both compatibility defaults, GDT/LDT, SS.B0/1, original-SP carries, saved-SP truncation, all 32 frame flag bits and narrow descriptor/frame aliases.
qualification.guard_pages: The last required frame byte borders PROT_NONE. The tests compare the full represented state and RAM and cover word flag preservation, same-CPL short frames and cleanup.

checks.name: Focused native, guarded-memory, SDK and lifting checks
Integrated continuation, original state, refinement and system-state checks

environment.temporary_files: Task TMPDIR and private user/mount namespace for GoogleTest CapturedStream, without modifying host mounts or assertions.
environment.intentional_child_faults: Task-local no-core helper loaded after namespace creation suppresses Apport for intentional test child faults.
